name: ThemeColorButton
description: An interactive button that allows users to cycle through available color themes. It displays a visual representation of the current theme's primary gradient color.
usage: Cycles through color themes with a single click
Visual indicator shows the current theme's gradient color
Matches the height and styling of the ThemeToggle component
Works with the portfolio's theme management system
Uses the `useEnhancedTheme` hook from the theme system
Maintains style consistency with other UI controls
Applies proper accessibility attributes (title and aria-label)
examples: // Combined with ThemeToggle (see ThemeSwitcher component)
design: The button displays a SwatchBook icon to represent color theme selection
Uses text-[var(--color-text-default)] for icon color consistency
Flex layout centers content for visual alignment
accessibility: Includes title attribute: 'Change color theme' for tooltip on hover
Includes aria-label: 'Cycle color theme' for screen readers
Interactive button element ensures keyboard accessibility
